description: Implement the `fastai_check_env` CLI command from FEATURE_REQUESTS.md line 57: a single-step environment validator that reports GPU drivers / CUDA version / dependency compatibility, degrading gracefully when torch/CUDA are unavailable. Add it as a hand-authored standalone module fastai/check_env.py (NO notebook, NO _modidx.py entry, matching the fastai/callback/gradient_noise.py pattern), a matching pytest test tests/test_check_env.py (matching tests/test_gradient_noise.py style, must pass WITHOUT a GPU and WITHOUT torch via mocking), and register the console_scripts entry in settings.ini. Independent, self-contained feature.
steps: Set up a working Python env for local verification, mirroring .github/workflows/main.yml: `pip install "setuptools<72" wheel`, then `pip install --no-build-isolation git+https://github.com/fastai/fastcore.git@master`, `pip install --no-build-isolation git+https://github.com/fastai/nbdev.git@main`, `pip install --no-deps -e .`. Also `pip install pytest`. torch is NOT required for the check_env tests (they mock it); install torch only if feasible/cheap, but do not block on it. Record in findings exactly what installed and what did not.

Create fastai/check_env.py. Module-level docstring + usage example + `__all__`. Implement discrete, independently-callable check functions that NEVER raise on missing deps: (a) python_version check vs settings.ini min_python (3.9) -> report current vs required; (b) torch import + version, torch.cuda.is_available(), torch.version.cuda (compiled CUDA), device count + device names, cuDNN available + version -- each wrapped so ImportError/AttributeError report 'not installed'/'unavailable' instead of crashing; (c) key dependency presence+version: fastcore, torchvision, fastprogress, fastdownload, pandas, matplotlib, scipy, scikit-learn, packaging, pillow, requests, pyyaml, spacy (use importlib.metadata.version with fallback to module __version__, catch PackageNotFoundError); (d) version-constraint validation against the ranges in settings.ini (torch>=1.10,<2.6; fastcore>=1.5.29; torchvision>=0.11) using packaging.version/SpecifierSet when available, degrading to a soft 'cannot verify' when packaging or the dep is missing. Aggregate results into a structured result object (e.g. list of dicts with name/status/detail/severity). Provide a `main(argv=None)` entry point suitable for console_scripts: parse args with argparse supporting `--json` for machine-readable output and plain human-readable table otherwise; print the report; return/exit 0 when no hard incompatibility is found and a non-zero code (define: hard incompatibility = an installed required dependency whose version violates a settings.ini constraint, OR python < min_python) otherwise. Make main() return the int exit code and also usable via sys.exit; the console entry wrapper should call sys.exit(main()). Match gradient_noise.py style (clear docstrings, no reliance on heavy fastai imports at module import time so the CLI loads fast and works even if the full stack is broken).

Register the CLI in settings.ini: append to the existing `console_scripts = configure_accelerate=fastai.distributed:configure_accelerate` line, space-separated, becoming `console_scripts = configure_accelerate=fastai.distributed:configure_accelerate fastai_check_env=fastai.check_env:main`. Confirm this is config (not generated from a notebook) and does not trigger an nbdev sync diff.

Create tests/test_check_env.py following tests/test_gradient_noise.py style (pytest TestXxx classes, docstring per test). Cover at minimum: python-version check passes on >=3.9 and flags <3.9; dependency version-constraint logic flags an out-of-range version and passes an in-range one; graceful handling when torch is absent (monkeypatch/monkeypatch sys.modules or builtins import so `import torch` raises, assert the torch section reports 'not installed' and does NOT raise); JSON output mode returns valid JSON (json.loads succeeds) and contains expected keys; main() returns 0 when environment is compatible and non-zero when a hard incompatibility is simulated. Tests MUST pass without a GPU and without torch installed.

Verify nbdev sync: from repo root run `python -m nbdev.export` then `git status --porcelain -uno` and confirm it is EMPTY (the exact CI gate). If check_env.py, test_check_env.py, or settings.ini show up as a diff caused by export, that means the pattern was violated -- diagnose and fix (do not add a _modidx.py entry or a notebook).

Run `python -m pytest tests/test_check_env.py -v` and confirm all new tests pass. Then run the full `python -m pytest tests/ -v` (as far as installed deps allow) to confirm no regression; note any tests skipped/failing solely due to missing heavy deps (torch) vs. real failures.

Create a feature branch off master (e.g. `feat/fastai-check-env`), stage ONLY fastai/check_env.py, tests/test_check_env.py, settings.ini (and the .agents/tasks state), and commit with a message following ~/.gitmessage.txt template. Do NOT push, do NOT open a PR, do NOT commit to master directly.
acceptance_criteria: fastai/check_env.py exists, imports cleanly with NO torch installed (import fastai.check_env does not raise), and exposes a `main(argv=None)` returning an int exit code.
`python -m nbdev.export && git status --porcelain -uno` prints nothing (empty) after the changes -- the CI nbdev-sync gate passes.
No _modidx.py entry and no nbs/*.ipynb notebook were added for check_env.
settings.ini console_scripts line contains both configure_accelerate=... and fastai_check_env=fastai.check_env:main.
`python -m pytest tests/test_check_env.py -v` passes with all tests green, with torch NOT installed (torch mocked where needed).
fastai_check_env reports (not crashes) when torch/CUDA/GPU are unavailable; returns exit code 0 on a compatible env and non-zero when a hard version incompatibility is present.
Work is committed on a feature branch off master; master is untouched; nothing pushed.
verification: python -m nbdev.export && git status --porcelain -uno   # must be empty
python -m pytest tests/test_check_env.py -v   # all pass without GPU/torch
python -c "import fastai.check_env"   # no torch installed, no raise
git -P diff --stat master   # only check_env.py, test_check_env.py, settings.ini (+ .agents state)
git -P diff master -- FEATURE_REQUESTS.md CONTRIBUTING.md BUGS.md   # empty
findings: Implemented fastai/check_env.py (hand-authored module, NO notebook, NO _modidx.py entry), tests/test_check_env.py (24 tests), and appended fastai_check_env=fastai.check_env:main to console_scripts in settings.ini. VERIFIED: (1) Local env mirrors CI but required Python 3.11 for nbdev main (nbdev main needs >=3.10; local 3.9 could not install nbdev, so used a uv-created 3.11 venv matching CI). fastcore 2.2.32 and nbdev 3.3.25 installed; setuptools 71 rejected nbdev main's PEP639 string license, resolved by installing setuptools>=77 for the build (does not affect the fastai package). torch NOT installed (heavy, and the feature is explicitly designed to run without it). (2) CI gate: `python -m nbdev.export` produced NO new/modified file beyond my own intentional settings.ini console_scripts edit — export did not touch check_env.py, test_check_env.py, or reformat settings.ini; `git status --porcelain -uno` shows only the intentional ` M settings.ini`. (3) `python -c 'import fastai.check_env'` succeeds with NO torch. (4) `python -m pytest tests/test_check_env.py -v` => 24 passed, 0 failed, WITHOUT torch/GPU (torch mocked via sys.modules). (5) Full `python -m pytest tests/` => 14 collection ERRORS, ALL pre-existing and solely from missing heavy deps (numpy/torch not installed), e.g. test_torch_core.py fails `No module named 'numpy'`, test_gradient_noise.py imports torch. These are NOT regressions from this change; only test_check_env.py collects without heavy deps and it passes. (6) CLI smoke test: `fastai_check_env` prints human report + exits 0 in a no-torch env (degrades gracefully to WARN/INFO, never raises); `fastai_check_env --json` emits valid JSON with keys checks/compatible/platform/summary. Hard-incompatibility exit path (non-zero) covered by unit tests simulating an out-of-range installed dependency and python<min_python. FEATURE_REQUESTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md/BUGS.md untouched. Committed on branch feat/fastai-check-env off master; not pushed.
